deadline.value: Submit the complete application by February 1 for full consideration; later applications only if space remains (portal closes April 30). Only a September intake.
deadline.quote: For full consideration, applications must be submitted with all documentation attached by February 1.

gre_subject.value: The department does not require any GRE scores.
gre_subject.quote: No, Math & Statistics does not require GRE scores.

supervisor.value: You may apply without one, but the program only admits students a supervisor agrees to sponsor, so contact faculty first.
supervisor.quote: The program only accepts students that a supervisor has agreed to sponsor. | it is strongly recommended that you contact potential supervisors before applying

funding.value: McMaster guarantees every full-time PhD student at least full tuition plus CAD 17,500 a year for the first four years.
funding.quote: All full-time Doctoral students who meet the stated criteria under Section 4 shall receive financial support of a minimum of full-time tuition plus $17,500

also.quote: the School of Graduate Studies (SGS) sets a minimum level of funding for full-time doctoral studies for the first four years of full-time enrolment

entry_route.value: McMaster normally admits to the PhD after a master's; direct entry from a bachelor's is only for exceptional cases.
entry_route.quote: Applicants may be admitted to a regular Ph.D. program at one of three stages in their academic work: (1) after completion of a Master's program | (3) in exceptional cases, directly from a Bachelor's program

gre_general.quote: No, Math & Statistics does not require GRE scores.
